title: Critique: the universe would hold contradictory thoughts

statements.text: Albahari worries that if the universe bears all the conscious states of every local subject, it has all their thoughts, and since people’s views contradict, the universe would have contradictory thoughts. Goff answers that on hybrid cosmopsychism the universe does not bear human consciousness, only the aspects of phenomenal properties that local subjects do not bear.

sources.quote: which would seem to imply that the universe has contradictory thoughts
avoids this concern, as the universe does not bear human consciousness
